artifact.reason: Current server setup with Fastify, CORS, health check, and graceful shutdown. Needs refactoring to extract app setup to src/app.ts and add missing middleware (helmet, correlation ID, error handler, OpenAPI).
Provides DatabaseService.healthCheck() method (line 37-46) - reuse for health endpoint database connectivity check. Singleton pattern already implemented.
Environment validation function with EnvironmentConfig interface. Extend this to add PORT, CORS_ORIGIN, LOG_LEVEL validation for Fastify configuration.
Existing Vitest test suite. Follow same patterns for Fastify integration tests (health endpoint, CORS headers, error handling).
Already has fastify, @fastify/cors, @fastify/env, pino. Need to add: @fastify/helmet, @fastify/swagger, @fastify/swagger-ui, fastify-type-provider-zod, zod.

constraints.constraint: Fastify app setup must be extracted to src/app.ts separate from server startup (src/index.ts). Enables testing without starting server.
Global error handler must be registered BEFORE route registration to catch all errors.
CORS middleware must be configured before route registration to allow frontend API calls.
Maintain singleton pattern for Fastify application instance (consistent with DatabaseService pattern).
Use Pino for structured JSON logging with correlation IDs (Fastify default logger).
Error response format must match standardized structure defined in @perrache/types package.
Health check response structure must match existing format from Story 1.2 (status, timestamp, services.database).
Environment variables must be validated on startup using existing env.ts pattern (extend for PORT, CORS_ORIGIN, LOG_LEVEL).
Hot reload must use tsx (already installed) for development - already configured in package.json dev script.
Testing framework is Vitest (already configured) - follow existing test patterns from __tests__/database.test.ts.
OpenAPI documentation must be served at /docs with interactive UI for "dogfooding" (Perrache catalogs itself).
Apply graceful shutdown handlers to Fastify server (SIGTERM/SIGINT) consistent with DatabaseService shutdown pattern.

interface.name: DatabaseService.healthCheck()
interface.description: Returns true if database connection is healthy, false otherwise. Use this for health endpoint database status check.

interface.name: validateEnvironment()
interface.description: Validates required environment variables and returns config object. Extend EnvironmentConfig interface to add PORT, CORS_ORIGIN, LOG_LEVEL.

interface.name: GET /health
interface.description: Current implementation (lines 32-73) already exists. Needs to be refactored to src/routes/health.ts with Zod schema validation and proper error handling.

interface.name: Error Response Format
interface.signature: { error: { code: string, message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown> } }
interface.description: Standardized error response format. Define ErrorCode enum with INVALID_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, INTERNAL_ERROR.

tests.standards: Vitest is configured as the testing framework (vitest.config.ts exists). Tests are located in src/__tests__/. Use async/await patterns for integration tests. Follow existing database.test.ts structure: setup/teardown hooks, descriptive test names, proper assertions. Test all acceptance criteria: health endpoint (200 and 503 responses), CORS headers, error handling, correlation IDs in logs, OpenAPI /docs accessibility, hot reload functionality.
